notes.title: Black Ink 2023.5
notes.content:
[b]Nice Update Including Symmetry and DomainWrap Operators[/b]

What's New
Watch the update video here:

[previewyoutube=geHWD5-q7jQ;full][/previewyoutube]

New Features and Improvements
[b]Symmetry Operator:[/b] One of the most requested features is now available. Create intricate symmetrical patterns effortlessly. Mirror along the X or Y axis for stunning repetitive designs.

[b]DomainWrap Operator:[/b] Ideal for creating seamlessly tiling textures. This operator folds any texture onto itself, blending layers to ensure perfect tiling without visible seams.

[b]Tiling Operator:[/b] We've fixed and enhanced the Tiling operator, which previously could generate 'holes' on loops. This issue has been resolved, ensuring smooth and continuous tiling.

Non-Destructive and Real-Time Updates
All changes are non-destructive and update in real-time. You can always tweak parameters and effect areas as needed.

For a detailed list of bug fixes, improvements, and new features, check out our [url=https://blackink.bleank.com/Support/Changelog/#20235]ChangeLog[/url].

notes.title: Black Ink 2020.2 nonAVX
notes.content:
Dear Black Ink user,

Some users have reported instant crashes with the introduction of Black Ink version 2020.2.
This is due to the use of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advanced_Vector_Extensions?oldformat=true]AVX instructions[/url] in the Black Ink code.
These instructions are available for most CPUs released from 2011 onwards. However some older CPUs do not support these instructions.
That's why the non AVX version of Black Ink is available under Steam as follows: 

[i]Launch Steam, go to your library and choose Black Ink in your softwares.
In the left column, right click on Black Ink to open its contextual menu and select "properties".

In the properties page select the Betas tab
Then select the [b]"nonavx"[/b] version from the dropdown menu just above.[/i]


[b]Please note that this version may be the last one to be non AVX and that we advise you, if you can, to change your CPU to a more recent one in order to continue to enjoy the next updates.
[/b]

Thank you for your understanding

[h1]The Version[b] 0.301.2448[/b] is now available[/h1]


[img]https://trello-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/50bf3f4076a627ab3200a072/511268ae8a42fd2b2c0099d5/0867026cc0ddf82e397c5df6ffbcc415/Release_BlackInk_Tittle.png[/img]

Hello everyone and happy new year!

We’re very glad to announce a new major update for Black Ink!
This update is very important as it offers brand new tools that will expand even more the field of brush creation.
It took a lot of time and effort to integrate these new powerful tools, while ensuring the continuity of performance and comfort you have always been used to experience with previous versions of Black Ink.
This is why we hope that you will like using it as much as we liked making it.

Hello,

We’d like to give a warm thank you to all of you for supporting Black Ink’s development and reassure you about our releases. 

We had some negative comments recently and we’re very sorry about the next release taking that much time. We wanted to add a very ambitious and powerful feature to Black Ink and this was a colossal task. The release after next one will be one of these and will come much faster.

Please be assured your patience will be well worth it!

One more word about pricing. Even though Black Ink is not listed as Early Access on Steam anymore, this is still how we work and that’s why we didn’t change the price yet. There are still a lot a features we want to add before calling Black Ink a final product and purchases made right now still represent a huge discount on the final price.

Thanks again for your patience and support!

Dear Black Ink users,

We’re happy to announce a new release! 

Following the introduction of floating windows in the last release, we added a new “Secondary Viewport” which provides a second, independent view of your document to save unnecessary navigation while you work. It has all the common navigation and drawing capabilities of the main view to give you as much freedom as possible and create your own workflow.

We also added a log window to follow what’s happening inside Black Ink and a Preference window. This first batch of options in the preferences will help you set-up and troubleshoot your tablet as well as adjust GPU options.

On the drawing side, you can now choose whether or not to have a constant screen brush size and flip your canvas horizontally or vertically with corresponding shortcuts. Very useful for sketches!

About future updates, we are still working on our fill tools which are shaping up to be a very interesting and complementary addition to Black Ink’s features.

As always thank you for your support and see you again soon for more news!

Bleank Team.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Iy9B30sLi7E][img]https://trello-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/511268ae8a42fd2b2c0099d5/640x360/e6faf97652dc82a502ec93dc60e055cf/150511_videocapture_640.jpg[/img][/url]

[*] [i][b]New[/b][/i]  Preferences Panel ( can be accessed from [i][b]Main Menu > Edit[/b][/i] or [i][b]Main Menu > Window[/b][/i])
[list]
[*]Stylus Section : User can now monitor some parameters of their stylus.
[list]
[*] A calibration process is accessible now if Black Ink doesn’t retrieve correct stylus position.
[*] The [b]Reset[/b] button sets the calibration values back to the driver’s default.
[*] The [b]Precise stylus calibration[/b] check box discards the tablet driver’s stylus position and relies on the system’s mouse position (less accurate)

[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  Random crash when changing color after clicking the color button in parameter editor.
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  Crash when using the Transform tool on little canvas.

[*] The maximum zoom limit is now 6400% instead of 1600%
[*] TestPanel 1 and TestPanel 2 have been removed.
[/list]

[h1]The Version[b] 0.205.1923[/b] is now available [/h1]

As promised in our last annonce, a new Black Ink release is out!

The most important new features are customizable layout, multi-monitor support and stroke smoothing.

[img]https://trello-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/511268ae8a42fd2b2c0099d5/640x554/13267a081ef2a366617e53035d65fa8a/150127_newfeat-640.png[/img]

[i]List of changes :[/i]

[list]
[*] [i][b]New[/b][/i]  DirectX11 renderer when available
[*] [i][b]New[/b][/i]  [b]Hold Z[/b] shortcut: set the drawing smoothness
[*] [i][b]New[/b][/i]  The Controller Editor can now be dragged out of Black Ink’s main window. More panels will have this behavior in future versions.
This feature shows the new Stacking capacity for such windows in Black Ink. However, some controls/editors are fixed to their place to keep a consistent UI.
[*] [i][b]New[/b][/i]  [b]Ctrl+←[/b] shortcut: Toggle Black Ink main window left panel
[*] [i][b]New[/b][/i]  [b]Ctrl+↓[/b] shortcut: Toggle Black Ink main window bottom panel
[*] [i][b]New[/b][/i]  [b]Ctrl+→[/b] shortcut: Toggle Black Ink main window right panel
[*] [i][b]New[/b][/i]  [b]M[/b] shortcut: Toggle Brush Manager panel ( for the moment this panel is fixed and can’t be dragged out )
[*] [i][b]New[/b][/i]  [b]Ctrl+T[/b] shortcut: Transform current selection
[*] Improved Framerate when drawing.
[*] Black Ink window can be resized by the dragging the top border
[*] In the transform tool, after clicking a command button (like “flip horizontally”) the focus is not tied to this button anymore, so that pressing Enter validates the current transform.
[*] You can now click on the brush and eraser icon in the top right part of Black Ink to directly select the last brush or the eraser ( same as B and E shortcut )
[*] An option have been added in the Zoom tool to enable/disable zooming at more than 100%. 
[*] When using the [b]Save[/b] command on a document which isn’t a BKD, the program automatically transforms the command into a [b]Save As[/b].
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  Sometimes when doing Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V on big images, the copied content isn’t polluted with some invalids squares anymore.
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  The Color Blending mode doesn’t output blocky results when using dark color
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  Crash in trial version when saving when the trial time has expired ( [url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=981#p3122]issue[/url] ) 
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  Random crash after loading a BKD
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  Crash when importing a grayscale JPG
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  Several ( all ? ) random crashes when using the program
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  If the Selection or Transform properties are opened in the sidebar panel, clicking the "Show Brush manager" has effect ( [url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=941&p=2949#p2948]issue[/url] )
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  When hovering the Selection and Transform tools, the popups can disappear under the cursor, and you can only get them back by moving the cursor out of the panel and back into it. ( [url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=941&p=2949#p2948]issue[/url] ) 
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  With multiple monitor, the Black Ink Window is moved to another monitor when activating the application.
[/list]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GfiqlKzisow][img]https://trello-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/511268ae8a42fd2b2c0099d5/1280x720/01307eea2eba00962dcb5451b480d5fe/150127_videocapture1280.jpg[/img][/url]

This new version was a lot of work because we added some substantial internal features, which led to significant changes in the core - but it was well worth it because it will allow us to integrate powerful features more easily!

Black Ink’s OpenGL renderer is also underway, and will eventually lead to the Mac OS X version.

Anyway thank you for your support and patience.

See you soon

Bleank Team.

notes.title: Welcome to Black Ink December's newsletter!
notes.content:
[img]https://trello-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/51dd6c6355bcec6f0f001e2d/640x214/cd1f80d0c7537001f47f13d2007750d7/Bi_14-12_head-snow.png[/img]

Black Ink development is still going at a steady rate, and while it has been a few months since the last release, the next one is coming up next January.

We have been working on some substantial internal features that changed the core of the software and needed some time. These internal changes will allow us to add important features we have planned for the next few releases.

[img]https://trello-attachments.s3.amazonaws.com/51dd6c6355bcec6f0f001e2d/640x348/01b2845c09640d0a5ec5c779ee69745b/Bi_14-12_wip.jpg[/img]

In the meantime, we have started to port Black Ink to Mac OS X - follow this [url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=29&t=49]link[/url] to see the upcoming features.

Last but not least, you have been quite a few to ask for Black Ink tutorials.
We began a Getting started series. Have a look and give us feedback!

notes.title: Black Ink 0.161.1686
notes.content:
[h1]The Version[b] 0.161.1686[/b] is now available[/h1]

Long time since the last update. Due mainly to lot of personal duty for the team members.
Anyway this version mainly introduces more complex layer operations (which is the most requested features from the community).

Please note that this is the last release before a discount update which will occur in one week from this post. So if you are still undecided for Black Ink make your decision before the end of the next week, or it will cost you few more bucks ;)

Many thanks to all the users who already purchased Black Ink! The community grows every day and we are really amazed by your great feedback on our product.

[i]Now here the list of changes :[/i]

[list]
[*] [b]New[/b] User can now use the .JPG image format in Black Ink for saving and loading.
[*] [b]New[/b]  Command Menu for each layer (in the upper left of the layer thumbnail) :
[list]
[*][b]Duplicate Layer[/b]
[*][b]Fill[/b] - Fill the layer with the given solid color
[*][b]Transform[/b] - Transform the whole layer
[*][b]Merge Down[/b] - Merge down the layer
[*][b]Merge Visible[/b] - Merge all visible layers
[*][b]Merge All[/b] - Merge All layers into a flattened image
[*][b]Export Image[/b] - Export the layer as an image
[*][b]Import Image[/b] - Import an image in the layer[/list]
[*] [b]New[/b]  You can Drop an image file from the Window Explorer to open it. If it’s a .BKD it will open the document but if it’s another file format( .JPG, .PNG ) it will import it in the current selected layer.
[*] [b]New[/b]  T shortcut ( Transform the current selected layer ).
[*] [b]New[/b]  “General Shortcuts” section added in the Toolbar.
[*] [b]New[/b]  “Transform” section added in the Toolbar.
[*] [b]New[/b]  Transform Editor ( invoked when user starts a Transform operation )
[list]
[*]You can set the opacity of the current transformed object before applying the transformation
[*]Center the transformed object
[*]Tile the transformed object thought the entire canvas
[*]Fit the transformed object thought the entire canvas
[*]Fill the canvas with transformed object content
[*]Flip the Transformed object Horizontally or vertically 
[*]Reset the Transformed aspect ratio back to its original size[/list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  The Eraser function of stylus is not recognised on new Intuos PRO ( [url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=663&p=2080#p2080]issue[/url] ) 
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  Impossible to Pin the Black Ink.exe in the TaskBar ( [url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=727&p=2093#p2093]issue[/url] )
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  Problem when resizing the application window with the controller panel opened ( [url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=790&p=2328#p2328]issue[/url] )
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  Crash when using the stylus Eraser when brushing with the mouse.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  Crash when switching to the stylus Eraser when editing some Controller parameter
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  Crash when selecting the Crepe Default Brush, editing the 2nd color and drag&dropping one of the color-markers away (to remove it)
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  Brush Preview flooding when Dragging out controller block from a slot without destroying it. A Preview was created each time the user start to draw while it was unnecessary.
[*] [b]Fixed[/b]  Black Ink Window is correctly placed when Maximized with a Task bar pinned on the left, right or top of the desktop ( [url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=338&p=1118]issue[/url] )
[*] An Empty= Layer is created above the default white Background when the New command is invoked ([url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=807]request[/url])
[*] The Shortcut [b]Esc[/b] that sometimes close Black Ink has been removed.[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]The Version 0.144.11617 is now available[/h1]

[i]list of changes :[/i]

[list]
[*] [i][b]New[/b][/i] "[i]Main Menu > Edit > Disable Precise Stylus position[/i]" This option is useful If you still encounter stroke offsets after using Reset Stylus Calibration. This will read position from the mouse pointer and only take the pressure from the tablet’s pen.
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  Crash when press on the [b]num pad ‘9’[/b] ( [url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=414]more infos[/url] )
[*] [i][b]Fixed[/b][/i]  Precision issue when sketching. Now Black Ink is more accurate with the stroke input and should follow closely what you do with your tablet (if you have not [i]Disabled Precise Stylus position[/i] see above). (  [url=http://forum.bleank.com/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=289&p=911#p906]more infos[/url]  )
[*] The way the Speed is computed from stroking has changed. It’s now more accurate and reflect better the dynamic. Warning if you have created some of which use speed, their look could have changed.
[*] The way are handled Mouse positions has been changed : a smoothing is applied which induce a little latency but a smoother stroke result and a better Pressure simulation.
[*] The old Menu in front of the current brush name has been removed. ( he will be replaced by a new one in a future version ).
[/list]
